note: The band token + latency budgets the eval suite reads as VERSIONED DATA (design impl-review-v1 §3.5: 'the band token/latency budgets as versioned data'; the run runtime is 'budgeted as data beside the calibration table'). These are STARTING VALUES tuned only by a reviewed data PR (the calibration-governance class) — never a code edit. A removal or a relaxation is a reviewed decision. The eval harness loads this file CLOSED (an unknown key is an error) and enforces the per-band budgets on the live suite; the diff-read byte budgets that bound the truncation family live beside these in internal/implreview/band (BandBudgets) — this file carries the COST budgets (tokens, latency) the review runtime is held to per band.
